description: Defines an interface for producing connection events, intended for monitoring or debugging connection-oriented protocols like MQTT or AMQP. It includes nested context interface for passing message sender clients, and methods for handling connection and disconnection events with relevant parameters.

classes.name: ConnectionEventProducer
classes.description: An interface for producing connection events, such as connections and disconnections, for monitoring purposes.

classes.name: ConnectionEventProducer.Context
classes.description: A nested interface providing context for connection event producers, mainly supplying a message sender client.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Produces an event indicating a new connection has been established, with details like remote ID, protocol adapter, optional authenticated device, and additional data.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Produces an event indicating a connection has been closed, with details similar to the connected method.
